prompt.text:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of GULPER. Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. Keep the exact design, silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials, top-left lighting, outline weight and rendering style of the reference in every cell; only the pose or state changes from cell to cell, and the layout follows the grid described: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shooter, a regular grid of six equal cells in two rows of three with even gutters, read left to right and top to bottom, every cell showing the same GULPER enemy — a huge-headed deep-sea fish machine with a cavernous pale-bone hinged jaw cage, tiny vicious eyes, a charcoal-green body and a lure filament glowing pale cyan above its head, side view facing left, at the same scale and position, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. The frames in order: cruising with the jaw half-open, jaw closing, jaw shut, lunge with the jaw thrown wide and the lure flaring, bite-close with cyan sparks, damaged with a cracked jaw and a dark frayed lure. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical silhouette and palette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 The jaw clearly changes: half-open in cell one, nearly closed in cell two, shut with the teeth interlocked in cell three, gaping wider than the reference with the lure blazing bright in cell four, snapping shut with cyan sparks in cell five, and in cell six the jaw cracked and the lure bulb dark and frayed. Only green space between the cells, no lines.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, watermark, blurry, green tint on the subject, green spill
